description: Pay another Gloam private account on Solana (its registered private address) from this agent's private balance. Gloam's relay pays the fee. HIDDEN: the asset and the amount. VISIBLE: this agent's private account and the recipient's private account (sender and recipient are not hidden on Solana). Proofs are made by Helius's prover. Passes the owner's spending limits as tool "pay" on network "solana-mainnet".

amount.description: Amount in whole units, like "2.5" (not base units).

asset.description: SOL, USDC, USDT or ZEC (Zcash bridged to Solana by NEAR's Omni Bridge; private once added, the bridge and the add are public).

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Solana, in ms (default 120000). A send still unsettled then comes back pending with its signature and blockhash.

to.description: The recipient's Gloam private address on Solana (base58). It must be registered.

name: gloam_solana_pay
title: Pay privately on Solana
